input.quote: Customer agrees that, during the Term, Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services which are included in the Monthly Base Fee, as set forth on Schedule 6.2.
input.rationale: Section 8.1(ii) imposes a minimum monthly fee (the Monthly Base Fee), § 8.13 makes it payable in advance by ACH debit, and § 10.3(A) requires Customer to keep buying every Service in the Monthly Base Fee for the entire eight-year Term (§ 1.X) with no descope or reduction right. The only escape is § 11.1, which requires one year's notice plus a percentage of the Estimated Remaining Value (computed off the Monthly Base Fee for all remaining months), i.e. a penalty rather than a true-up. That is a multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction right, which is walk-away territory and fails every fallback element. We have taken the fallback rather than preferred because deleting the minimum entirely would require collateral rewrites to §§ 8.1, 8.13 and the Estimated Remaining Value definition: the commitment is confined to the then-current twelve-month period, made reducible on 30 days' notice, and any shortfall is trued up rather than penalised. The § 11.1 convenience fee itself is a termination-right issue addressed under that rule, not re-flagged here.

mappings.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.

proposal.summary: Limit the Monthly Base Fee sourcing commitment to the current 12-month period, with a 30-day reduction right and a true-up instead of a shortfall penalty.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot take a minimum-fee commitment locked for the full eight-year Term with no way to descope. We have limited the commitment to the then-current twelve-month period and added a 30 days' notice reduction right with a true-up rather than a shortfall penalty, consistent with our fallback position.

ops.newText: Customer agrees that, during the then-current twelve (12) month period of the Term only, Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services

ops.text: Customer may reduce the Services included in the Monthly Base Fee, and the corresponding Monthly Base Fee commitment, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to M&I. Any resulting shortfall shall be handled solely through a true-up of the Monthly Base Fee to the Services actually ordered and used, and not as a penalty.
